verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a full time-off request lifecycle — balance checking, submission, admin approval, and payroll integration (gusto-docs-11, gusto-docs-19, gusto-docs-29, gusto-docs-51) — and admins can approve/decline requests via embedded UI or API (gusto-docs-55). However, evidence never shows ops users configuring accrual rules/policies (rates, caps, carryover) themselves; the docs describe consuming existing balances rather than defining accrual policies. Missing for 10: explicit accrual-policy configuration UI/API, evidence of automatic policy-driven accrual calculation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of policy setup.
